title: Implement FT-001 ActorContext and role policy
verify: ActorContext resolves request_id, session, account, Farm, membership, role, auth provenance, and PlantPermissionContext resolver before business logic.
Role preset policy matches Boss, Engineer, and Consultant authority from FT-001.
Consultant cannot operate, create domain task/recommendation records, approve governance by default, or approve physical actions.
PlantPermissionContext interface remains compatible with FT-002 resolver ownership and does not implement PlantAccessGrant mutations.
T3 closure includes /verify PASS, /red-verify semantic-pass, HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done, and ROLLBACK_RECOVERY_NOTE: present.
constraints: Every protected route/context-builder path must require ActorContext before business logic.
The only MVP per-Plant permission override is plant_approve_actions.
Do not add a general ACL engine or permission override matrix.
Do not implement FT-002 PlantAccessGrant persistence or mutation routes.
invariants: Frontend hide/show is presentation only and never an authorization substitute.
Consultant remains advisory/read/comment only by default.
can_approve_actions is actor authority only and never Safety Gate clearance.
purpose: Create the ActorContext and role/Plant permission boundary that later Farm/Plant routes and context builders must consume.
success_outcome: Protected backend paths can require a typed ActorContext and derive role/Plant permission decisions without duplicating FT-002 access rules.

forbidden_scope: FT-002 PlantAccessGrant persistence or mutation routes
stop_conditions: ActorContext shape conflicts with FT-001 tech spec.
Permission resolver requires unresolved FT-002 implementation decisions.
Consultant or missing-grant behavior cannot be proven fail-closed.
